user.title: Link your Goldshell account

reauth_confirm.title: Goldshell token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The Goldshell Hub issues 30-day tokens and has no refresh, so the login needs renewing. Press **Submit** to scan a new QR code.

timeout.title: QR code expired
timeout.description: The login was not approved in time. Press **Submit** to get a fresh QR code.

login_error.title: Login failed
login_error.description: Something went wrong talking to the Goldshell Hub. Press **Submit** to try again.

progress.wait_for_scan: Waiting for you to approve the login in the Goldshell app…

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Goldshell Hub. Check your internet connection and try again.
abort.already_configured: This Goldshell account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The scanned account does not match the one being re-authenticated.
